name: How do I know if I need a new water heater?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a new water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate it might be time for a water heater replacement. These include a lack of hot water, rust-colored water, metallic smells, unusual noises like rumbling or popping from the tank, or visible leaks around the base. The age of your water heater is also a key factor; most traditional tank heaters last 8-12 years. If yours is older and showing any of these symptoms, a replacement is likely needed to avoid further issues and ensure reliable hot water supply.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include lack of hot water, rusty water, strange noises, leaks, or if your unit is over 10 years old. These indicate it's time for a replacement.
